name: XXII INTERNATIONAL CONGRESS MACHINЕS, TECHNOLОGIES, MATERIALS WINTER SESSION
description: I presented the article “Thermal Effects of High-Speed Machining: Analysis of Cutting Zone Temperatures, Tool Behavior, and Cutting Forces in C45 Steel Turning at Elevated Speeds” at this conference. The event focuses on bringing together researchers and industry experts to discuss innovations, exchange knowledge, and explore the latest developments in machines, technologies, and materials.

name: LASERTEC 80 Shape – 5-Axis Precision Laser Machining System
location: Centre of Excellence for 5-Axis Machining (CE5AM), MTF STU Trnava
description: Narrated overview of the DMG MORI LASERTEC 80 Shape laser machine at MTF STU Trnava: fiber laser parameters, 5-axis configuration and linear drives, control and software, the laser texturing process chain, fields of application, surface texture examples from CE5AM, typical process parameters, and safety requirements.

name: Laser Micromachining Research – Student Theses on the LASERTEC 80 Shape
location: Centre of Excellence for 5-Axis Machining (CE5AM), MTF STU Trnava
description: Narrated overview of seven student theses on laser micromachining with the LASERTEC 80 Shape: surface roughness of titanium GRADE 2 (Taguchi L9 design), micromachining of sintered carbide WC-Co, laser surface texturing of steels and its effect on friction (ring test, lubricant study), chip breaker production from CAD to laser and 3D scan, and texturing of injection mold cavities.

name: From GAMS to GAMSPy: Optimization Modelling in Python, from Model to Interactive Web Page
location: University of Tuzla, Faculty of Technology, Tuzla, Bosnia and Herzegovina
description: Guest lecture within the Erasmus+ programme. A hands-on introduction to optimization modelling: from the algebraic modelling language GAMS to GAMSPy in Python, a real engineering case (mixing of streams with sets, parameters and what-if analysis), and finally an interactive optimization web page built with Matplotlib and Flask.
notes: Available resources: Slides (PDF) · Code from the lecture (ZIP)
